assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission using the declared provisional constraints and submitted design layers; statutory controls and all boundary-dependent results still need official data and professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: No site-specific heat-exposure, canopy, thermal-comfort, or cooling-benefit baseline is claimed by this submission.
assumptions.impact: Cooling performance remains a testable design objective; pilots require calibrated instruments, declared sampling, seasonal comparison, and professional review before any benefit claim.

assumptions.statement: AI services use authorized aggregated inputs, public rules, expiry dates, stop conditions, and human review; essential cooling-refuge services remain usable without AI or a smartphone.
assumptions.impact: Any operator unable to meet service-equivalence, privacy, accessibility, and human-review requirements must not deploy the proposed AI scenario.
